description: Travel Times for key priority routes — July 2023 is a dataset listed in Peclet Queensland open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Transport and Main Roads. Queensland Traffic Data showing average travel times across each 15 minute period on key state controlled road network priority routes. Note this is the July 2023 file from the QLD Open Data portal. More (older) files are available at. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under Transport, Movements. Its keywords are roads, average travel times. The portal shows 520,738 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-03-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-queensland-portal.
